dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I probably shouldn't use all those names...

dialogues.speaker: Charlene
dialogues.text: Huh, is that a problem? I mean, the important thing is the incident details, not my title, right?

dialogues.speaker: Charlene
dialogues.text: Besides, the less people know our names, the better!

dialogues.speaker: Charlene
dialogues.text: A Gardes member's name only ever gets published in The Steambird when something goes wrong, anyway.
